title: Flaky Croatian Fish Clay-Pot-Cook
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish featuring flaky fish, fresh dill, and a hint of Mediterranean flavors. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the cod fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the clay pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sauté the chopped onions and minced garlic until softened.
Add the chopped fresh dill, lemon juice, and white wine (if using) to the pot.
Place the cod fillets on top of the vegetables and add water to cover them partially.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Remove the pot from the oven and carefully place it on a trivet or heat-resistant surface.
Remove the cod fillets from the pot and serve with the vegetables and sauce.
Strain the cooking liquid and discard the bay leaves.
Serve the sauce over the fish and vegetables, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
